title: 2-Time Champion Makes Interesting Claim Who Really Leads Celtics Between Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum - NewsBreak
text:
By Rolly Gacelo ,
1 hours ago Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown have been among—if not the best and most consistent—duos in the NBA for nearly a decade. Together, they have led the Boston Celtics to multiple playoff appearances and the 2024 NBA championship.
They have achieved plenty of success as a duo, but some people are still intrigued about their standing within the team. The never-ending question about who is the Batman and who is the Robin in their tandem is something people continue to ask .
This idea became more prominent this season as the Celtics have found success without Jayson Tatum, who hasn’t played since May last year.
Two-time NBA champion JR Smith wants to settle this debate . He is siding with Brown, saying that only the media favors Tatum. According to him, Brown is regarded by his colleagues and teammates as the better player.
“It’s always been his team. It’s his team for the players I’m pretty sure it’s his team, for everybody else in the media from the outside, it’s Jayson Tatum team,” Smith said in the To The Baha show hosted by several other former NBA players like Theo Pinson and Charlie Villanueva.
“That’s what they want it to look like, internally Jaylen Brown is the leader of that team, 100% on and off the court.”
Jayson Tatum’s return Tatum’s return is highly anticipated as fans are excited to see how he will fit into a team that is already achieving success without him.
An NBA insider said there is a chance he will play his first game of the season on Friday against their 2024 NBA Finals opponents, the Dallas Mavericks.
Injured Jayson Tatum joins Boston Celtics bench during game
Mandatory Credit: Petre Thomas-Imagn Images “I think we’re getting close. I’m actually in Boston on Tatum watch right now,” Chris Mannix said.
“And every indication I’ve been getting is that we are getting very close. I think Friday. You don’t want to put a percentage on it, but I think it’s certainly in play for Jayson Tatum. And certainly if it’s not Friday, it’s at some point quickly after that. I think we’ve gone past the point of uh. Will he be back? And now it’s down to when he will come back.”
